Pull CarrotBed_T1's back edge to y 26 or less (or lower the bed) so the back-left corner (x 0-12, y 26-31) and the trail mouth stay visible. Paint a path along BackLane, (0, 30.2) -> (14, 28.6), and put the strawberry patch on the dome's top.
After shared #1 lands, re-place Veg_Garden_Bed, X1000004_Carrot_Row and X1000004_Strawberry_Bush on T1, each at least 1.5 m from routes.

The stump arch reads as a solid wall. Shrink the eight stumps to radius 0.9-1.0. Cut ARCH_OVERLAP from 0.45 to about 0.15 and use short plank or root tongues as walk links, so air shows between the posts. Bow the middle stumps 2.5-3 m forward over the basin (they currently span y 14.6-16.45). Vary each cap: moss, a root flare, a tiny mushroom, a different bark tint.

The basin switchback ramps read as cardboard. Replace Ramp_T22_T21 (16.0, 9.4)->(13.4, 9.4), Ramp_T23_T22, Ramp_Basin_T23 and Landing_T22/T23 with short stone or turf stair flights, about 2.8 m wide, in one straight line from the shelf to the basin, each ending 0.5 m inside the upper cap. Drop the separate dirt landing pads.

The arrival is inverted. This needs shared #3: east00 moves to (37.0, 31.5, 10.0) and the map z drops from 18 to about 9.5; skip this fix if the anchor does not move. Delete GateLanding and EastLane (36, 12 -> 36, 28.6). Make the east end of the rim road the arrival landing, looking down into the bowl. Use the freed east strip (x 33-38, y 8-28) to widen the T15 east rim and the round stone stair. Re-declare the routes from the new east00.

The bowl is only 0.8 m deep. Raise the tier stack by about 1.2 m: the basin floor becomes a 0.3 m terrace, banks T16/T17 go to about 1.0 m and rims T14/T15 to about 2.0 m, joined by short grass ramps or one stone step on each side. Curve the rim outlines inward into a U around x 6-24 instead of straight strips. Re-check every vine z0/z1 and every route.

The four climbable vines (x 4.6, 15.6, 21.6, 30.6) are lost among the decorative ones. Cut Vine_Curtain from 18 to about 6 short strands (1 m or less), at least 2 m from LONG_VINES. Remove or shorten the 5 Vine_MidFace strands and the 2 dead-end vines. Give the climbable vines a brighter leaf material with flowers. At the top, mark each fence gap with a small arch or leaf-sign post and a light path patch where the vine starts.

The Main route drops 0.47 m at the plateau lip (13, 9). Start Steps_Plateau_Basin at (12.5, 9.0, 1.2) instead of (11.5, 9, 1.2), keeping the end at (16.0, 9.0, 0.0) and width 3.6. Rebuild and confirm the Main route reports 0 drops.

The knoll stairs look like scattered planks. End Valley_Path at about (22.2, 10.4) so it no longer drapes over Knoll_W_1, which starts at x 22.6. Space the three knoll flights so each landing ends at least 0.4 m before the next flight's foot. Make Knoll_W_2's top land inside Knoll_T2: the terrace edge at y 11.2 is at about x 28.16, but the flight currently tops out at 28.0. Do the same on the east side.

The four-block staircase became a bridge. Replace StoneStair, StoneBlock_0/1 and the flat Landing ramps with 4 grass-capped rock blocks rising diagonally from CentralTerrace near (23, 26) up to StairLanding and on to HighEast. Each block sits 0.6-0.8 m above the previous one, joined by 2-tread mini-stairs so no walk step exceeds 0.45 m. Keep the trees at (24, 19.5) and (46, 27.5) clear of the diagonal.

Ramp slabs stick out of terrace edges. Give Mound_W/Mound_E grass tops, or model the hump as a terrace with a sloped cap. Delete the flat Landing_To_HighWest (z0 == z1) and let StairLanding's outline overlap HighWest instead. Shorten Landing_To_HighEast so it ends 0.5 m inside the HighEast edge.

The upper band is hidden. Cut the back-row trees at (2, 39), (14, 39.5), (21, 38.5), (41, 39.5) and (50, 39) down to 2-3 at the back corners, at scale about 0.8. Rebuild the Spire as a slim tapered rock pillar about 5 m above UPPER with a grass-tuft cap, near HighWest's front-left (about x 6, y 30), and move Rope_Spire to match. Raise the Mound to +1.4 m with grassed ramps.
CentralTerrace (21-47 x 18-28.5) is empty. Add a red-leaf birch at (29, 24.5), a bush pair near (31, 26) and a few flower patches, all off the UpperLoop route.
Check ground_z(39.5, 17.7) at Vine_A's foot (z0=0). If it is about 1.0, the foot is inside Knoll_T1: set z0 to that height.

The west climb is cluttered. Remove Steps_Lawn_T2 (x 11.5-14.2, y 14) and Steps_T2_T3 (x 16.4-19.2, y 15.4), whose risers face away from the camera so they render as flat pads, together with the lamp posts at (15.0, 11.8) and (19.8, 13.4) and their fence runs. Optionally replace them with one ramp from (11, 14, 0) to (18.5, 16, 2). Keep the south double flight as the one climb. Shorten Verge_Path so it runs directly from in00 to the foot of the verge flight, move the Sign_Board from (21, 12.6) to about (21.5, 1.5), and put clover beds in the freed corner. Re-run the routes.
Extra houses: delete the v1 House_Mushroom_Blue at (3.8, 32). Keep House_Mushroom_BlueCone (37.8, 32.8) but raise it to scale 0.85 or more so its door is at least 1.5 m tall.
After shared #11 lands, merge ToSkyLadder and SkyIslet into one route through the sky-islet ladder.

The map is made of huge empty slabs. Cut Branch_T19 (x 14.2-27.9, y 13.4-26.6), Branch_T16 (x 27.2-38.8, y 13.4-28.6) and Canopy_T8 into branch-shaped shelves 4-6 m deep, linked by root or branch bridges (walk steps of 0.45 m or less), so the ground shows between them. Add undergrowth clusters (ferns, bushes, small blue/yellow mushrooms, logs) and 6-10 more trees on the remaining shelves, each at least 1.5 m from routes. Re-declare the routes.

There is no 'middle of the forest' spine. Move Tree_Giant_A from the back rim (17.2, 40.6, scale 0.9) forward to the centre of the composition, between the tower and the T19/T8 shelves: near (19, 22), or the nearest spot that is 1.5 m clear of routes. Use scale about 1.4 and a dark-bark broadleaf giant, not a white trunk, so it does not copy 1000001.

The jump tower reads as a gentle staircase. Instead of marching the 12 stones (radius 1.35, 0.42 m rise each) back along x 8.4-11.0, wind them round a central rock pillar of radius 2.5-3 m at 30-35 deg per stone. Cut the cap overlap to small tongues so slivers of air show, and give the stones mossy or shelf-fungus caps. Use rock rather than a tree trunk so it stays distinct from 1000001's spiral.

Traversal fail (route WestBed). Move X1020001_CratesTomatoes_05 from (11.4, 13.6), with its sack, to (12.6, 15.6) and (13.4, 15.9) on the bed's north edge, about 1.9 m off the (10.0, 15.2)->(14.2, 12.0) leg. Move the Scarecrow from (19.0, 8.2) to (17.2, 8.0), between rows and 1.8 m off the x=19 leg. Rebuild until MAP_TRAVERSAL_OK is True.

Front-edge wedges: start Slope_Bank_Furrow, Slope_Furrow_Hump, Slope_Hump_Furrow and Slope_Furrow_EastBank at about y 0.6 and add a bed-level terrace strip along y 0-1. Alternatively, extend the beds' terrace bodies under the slopes so no triangular void shows at the plinth edge.

The path over Ramp_West (x 10-15.6, y 7.5) breaks into stripes and leaves a flat sheet over the 1 m lip. Keep the path polyline on the ramp centreline, no wider than the ramp's 3.6 m, and split it into separate m.path calls on each side of every lip.

The giant orange mushrooms read as bushes. Move Mushroom_Giant_Orange from (53.8, 5.8) at scale 1.05 to (55.5, 4.5) at scale 2.0, and the other from (54.6, 10.8) at scale 0.8 to (55.8, 10.5) at scale 1.6, so they frame the end of the ground chain, with the log pile in front.

The plank stairs Stair_T23_Nook, Stair_Berry_Clover and Stair_T12_T18 read as loose boards. Replace them with grassy ramps (top_mat=None), or re-render after shared #6 and keep them only if they then read as solid steps.
Keep the Tomato Field entrance secret. Hide the tomato gate on this side in a hedge tunnel, and keep the giant tomato only on the Tomato Field side so the two ends are not copies.

The summit reward grove is squeezed. Pull T0_Summit's front edge forward to about y 38.5 for x 40-62, trimming T12_UpperEast's back to about y 38.4. Run the Summit route along about y 40. Re-place the grove (2 X40001_Tree_Birch_Teal, 2 Tree_Birch_Orange, Bush_A/C) at y 42-44, at least 1.5 m from the route. Add a flower bed or sign at the top of the ribbon stair. Confirm cleared_from_routes.

The stepping stones read as a heap of coins. Build the pillar T24 -> T19 as one rock column (one terrace body) with offset ledge caps, instead of the separate drums T24/T21/T20. Space the V stones so each cap shows a crescent of side wall below the next. Make the arch-leg stones wider and rockier than the lintel stones. Use darker rock sides (grass_rock from shared #13 when available).
The pit is a 0.6 m trench. Deepen it (meadow at 1.2, floor at 0), or turn it into a small creek with water so the plank bridge has a reason to exist. Re-check the bridge route.

The game's first route is fragmented. Extend Plateau_Path (ends at x 12.6; the stair top is at 13.5), T3_Path (ends at 20.2; the stair top is at 21.0) and Lane_Path (starts at 23.9; the stair foot is at 23.4) 0.3-0.5 m under each stair landing or foot. Join T2_Path into the descent so the dirt flows into every flight.

The stairs look like flat paving pads (2-3 huge treads per 0.8 m). Use more, shallower treads, or a narrower flight with chunky visible stone risers, and add rocks or flowers at each stair cheek. Re-check after shared #6.

Sera's laundry reads as flags. Unless shared #22 upgrades Clothesline_Laundry first, define a local X0_Laundry (Y-fork posts, a slightly sagging rope, shirt and trouser silhouettes plus one long white sheet, tilted as if in wind, and a butterfly on a post) and use it for both clotheslines.
After shared #11 lands, merge ToBluffLadder and BluffTop into one route from the lane, up the bluff ladder, to Sera.

Break the Weapon Store template without editing m1010001, which three maps import. Swap the plank floor for whitewashed stone flags or blue-and-white tiles. Replace the centred round rug with an off-centre rope-bordered rug. Replace the Crate and Barrel by the door ((2.4, 1.2) and (3.3, 1.0)) and the Armor_Stand (2.9, 5.3) with a fishing-net and lobster-pot corner. Hang a cargo net under the beam, and add a sea-view window with a light shaft on the back wall.

Three identical X60001_KnightArmor: keep the one at (9.7, 10.6). Replace those at (13.15, 7.5) and (10.6, 6.6) with varied goods: a blue-tabard mannequin without a helmet, a boots-and-gloves rack, a chainmail stand.
Replace the hide_render collision boxes Heap_Crate_0..4 and Top_Crate_A/B with shared #16's m.collider, or register the visible crate tops with m.add_ground, so they stop failing no_hidden_objects.

Optional: add a 0.45 m whitewashed entry step inside the door (x 1.6-3.0, y 2.0-3.4) and spawn the player on it. Add a walkable deck on the kiosk roof at about z 3.4, moving the awning under it, reached as a one-way 1.6 m drop from the beam end at (3.35, 10.95, 5.0).

Cap seam: the back and left cut shells meet at the apex with a visible V-notch (Overview about 735-760 x 190-230). Overlap the two shell grids by one column or row at the corner, or add a small ridge cap piece along the seam.

Props blend into the all-orange room. Darken the wainscot and floor trim, use blue or green textiles on the bed and rugs, and add a few cool-coloured jars. Fill the empty centre-left floor with an entry-nook shelf, a coat rack or a hearth rug.

The spiral jar-shelf treads read as loose floating wedges. Give each tread a visible collar on the pole and a solid body down to the tread below (or riser blocks), and add a simple rail on the outer edge. Make the shelf-hopping order clearer with a trail of lit jars or a contrasting tread colour.
Replace the hide_render proxies Chest_Lid, Crate_High and Crate_Low with shared #16's m.collider, or call add_ground on the visible _Vis meshes.

shared_fixes.fix: In MapCtx.scatter, tag every instance it creates (obj['scattered'] = True). In traversal.clear_routes (traversal.py around line 223), delete only tagged instances, and never delete anything tagged 'landmark' or placed with m.place. Report authored Trees/Foliage/Rocks hits as 'blocked', with the route name and sample xy, so MAP_TRAVERSAL_OK goes False. Print every deletion (asset and xy) in the build_map output. Then rebuild all maps. The props deleted in iter1 (about 96, including the 1000001 GiantTrunk, the 50000 mesa birch, the 1000006 umbrella leaf, 28 props in 1000002, and items in 1000000/1000003/1000004/1000005/40001/40002) will then surface as blocked routes for authors to fix.
shared_fixes.rationale: Confirmed in code: clear_routes deletes by asset category (CLEARABLE_CATEGORIES) with no provenance check, contrary to its docstring. It removed three landmarks named in the briefs, and every iter1 render shows the degraded result. This must land before any map author re-places props, or the next rebuild deletes them again.

shared_fixes.area: Validator: portal reachability and honest pass/fail (traversal.py, scripts/validate.py)
shared_fixes.fix: (a) For every edge and door portal, require at least one route point within 1.5 m in xy and +/-0.45 m in z, with the route's last segment walking onto the portal's ground. Otherwise emit a high-severity 'portal_unreachable'. (b) Raycast the 4.5 m corridor from each edge anchor to the footprint edge, and the trail _In/_Out strips, for non-clearable geometry, and report hits as portal issues. (c) In validate.py, emit an issue line for every climbable_issues and out_of_bounds_terrain entry; 40002 and 1000001 currently fail with no reason given. Either add the portal-grounding raycast the docstring promises or remove the claim. (d) Add m.ladder(..., descend_only=True): skip foot_ok but require ground within MAX_DROP (2.6 m) below the foot. (e) Re-run validate.py after every build and commit the fresh VALIDATION.md; the current one predates the 06:23 validate.py edit.
shared_fixes.rationale: The 1.8 m wall in front of 1000000:in00 passed as MAP_TRAVERSAL_OK, and the Barrel_Door_Mounds in 1000003/1000004 sit in portal corridors without being reported. Map authors need a validator they can trust before the map wave starts.

shared_fixes.area: Layout corrections (layout.py): do these before map authors start
shared_fixes.fix: (a) LINKS (1010002, 'out00', 1010000, 'in01'): cut the gap from 12.0 to about 5.0. Both ends are at world z 8, so the trail stays flat. This pairs with deleting Amherst's exterior orange house, so Townstreet's cutaway becomes the one orange house. (b) 1010004: move anchor east00 from (37, 10, 0) to (37.0, 31.5, 10.0) and lower z from 18.0 to about 9.5. The player then arrives on the rim; the trail from Townstreet climbs about 11.5 m over 40 m (it needs #4's stairs and landings), and three plinth rings disappear. (c) 60000: move west00 from (8, 45) to (4.5, 45.0), out from behind the blue-domed house. (d) 1000001: raise out00's z from 2.0 to 4.4 for the arrival pillar. (e) LY.resolve(): log every auto-lengthened gap, and make it a build error when a gap exceeds 2.5x its authored value or overlap remains after +60 m. Fix the 1000005 link (12 m authored, 58 m resolved) and the 1000006 link (64 m) by changing bearings or anchors so both stay under about 25 m. Re-solve, then tell the affected authors (1010000, 1010002, 1010004, 60000, 1000001, 1000005, 1000006). Deliberately left out: re-anchoring 1000000's in02/in03 as a twin-door mound, and lowering 1000002 to make it a descent. Both cascade into other trails; revisit in iteration 2.
shared_fixes.rationale: Map authors cannot edit layout.py. These five changes unblock the top identity fixes for Amherst/Townstreet, Snail Field of Flowers, Southperry and Small Forest, and remove two 58-64 m straight causeways. Downstream maps shift when the layout is re-solved, so this has to happen first.

shared_fixes.fix: Use stairs or switchbacks when rise > 6 m OR slope > 20 deg. Today only slope > 28 deg triggers stairs, which is why the 27.3 deg drop from 30000 to 40000 and the 26.9 deg drop from 40002 to 50000 are single ramps with 12 m vertical walls. Add a flat landing every 3-4 m of rise. Build each trail as one swept ribbon along a smoothed polyline (p0, p1, p2, p3) so the _Out, middle and _In pieces leave no notches, and curve trails longer than 25 m through 1-3 waypoints along plinth edges. Replace the bottom=-2 vertical side walls with sloped grass flanks or bevelled banks with embedded rocks. Place Trail_Rail at half_width - 0.3 (it is currently at 2.35 m on a 2.1 m half-width), with its z raycast from the trail surface, or use one continuous rope rail. Inside a map, clip the trail at the footprint edge and drape a path ribbon on the map ground instead of the 1.2 m solid apron; fillet the perpendicular exit with a radius of 4 m or more, and lift the in-map part 2 cm to avoid z-fighting. Add a trail walk to traversal (portal to portal over world ground) and include the WORLD collections in the floating check.
shared_fixes.rationale: This is the single most visible artifact on the island: brown wedges with vertical walls and floating rails in every island and region shot, flagged by every critic. Nothing currently validates trails.

shared_fixes.fix: Where an m.ramp's upper end meets a terrace, notch or locally lower the upper cap's rounded lip and blend the ramp top flush into the cap, or auto-drape a 1.5 m path ribbon from the ramp onto the upper cap. Remove the detached flat end-extension sliver. Verify on 10000 Ramp_Meadow_Street, 30000 Slope_M2/Slope_S2, the 40000 landing ramps and the 1000004 basin ramps.
shared_fixes.rationale: Ramps read as cardboard sheets ending under a grass band, exactly where the route changes tier. 10000 already follows the AUTHORING rule, so this is a defect in shared code, not authoring.

shared_fixes.fix: Build each step as a solid block from the tread top down to p0.z - 0.3, with side_mat risers and cheeks. Make the top landing flush and thin (top at p1.z + 0.01, 0.06 thick), or skip it when p1 is already 0.5 m inside the terrace.
shared_fixes.rationale: Treads are currently 0.16 m floating boxes with no risers, so stairs read as loose tiles or boards lying on the grass in Amherst, 1020000, map 0, 20000, 40000, 1000000 and 50000.

shared_fixes.fix: (a) Use the one_way flag already computed in world.py (around line 307). Write o['one_way'] = True on the arrival-only portals (10000/20000/30000/40000:in00) and render them as a subtle ground ring or a welcome signpost/arch ('Welcome to Mushroom Town' at 20000), not a full swirl. (b) Redesign Portal_Door: replace the three stacked glowing discs (a 1.5 m 'snowman') with a flat emissive threshold glow plus a thin emissive outline on the door frame, or a small chevron at about 2.4 m. Nothing taller than 0.1 m should stand in front of a door opening.
shared_fixes.rationale: Every Maple Road link shows two swirls 12-16 m apart, implying a way back that the classic maps don't have. Door markers hide the landmark doors in 20000, 20001 and every shop.

shared_fixes.area: Island rim and cliff underside (world.island, world.underside, materials)
shared_fixes.fix: (a) Keep the hull, but add per-map, per-edge rim overrides, e.g. MAPS[60000]['rim'] = {'front': 2, 'east': 2}, MAPS[0]['rim'] = {'west': 0}, and 8 m or less on the SE edges of 1020000/1020001. Southperry's quay then becomes the island cliff (this enables the 60000 ship re-moor) and West Entrance sits on the NW tip. Add 2-3 shallow bays. (b) In underside(), keep the wall sheer for 50-70 m before it tapers, with levels about (-18, 1.0), (-40, 1.0), (-62, 0.98), (-88, 0.9), (-118, 0.72), (-150, 0.5), (-185, 0.27), (-215, 0.1) and the tip at about -250. Add vertical facet noise. Recolour M_Rock_Under to warm beige/khaki horizontal strata (#D2C29A / #B3A27A / #8E7F5E, wave distortion about 1.5). Move SEA_Z to about -420, and Cloud_CliffBase to z -110..-170 with half as many puffs.
shared_fixes.rationale: Every map sits 25-35 m inside the cliff, so the port is landlocked. The plateau reads as a thin pancake with wood-grain stripes, while the world map shows sheer grey-beige cliffs and the ship off the south rim.

shared_fixes.fix: (a) plinth(): fewer, taller, irregular rings (step heights varied 2-4.5 m, margins varied per side, outline wobble 3-5 m), mostly sloped grass with rock outcrops instead of vertical striped dirt risers. Merge the rings of adjacent maps into one hill mass. (b) scenery(): keep a 6-8 m low-shrub buffer behind each map's back edge and on its camera side, at least 15 m with no trees around the Mushroom Town maps (0/10000/20000/30000), and a Keepout of 8-10 m along main-road trails. (c) Mask forest density with low-frequency noise (about 0.01/m): roughly 50% dense, darker groves, 25% open flower meadow, and a 6-10 m tree-free strip along the rim. Cap autumn birches at about 15% outside the east region, and use pines and tall trees north of Field West. (d) Peak halos: place the Cloud_PeakRing puffs at radius 0.26*rad + puff radius + 2 m (about 0.5*rad), 8-10 flattened puffs per ring, only on tall Rocky peaks. Give cones faceting or tree cover.
shared_fixes.rationale: The rice-paddy plinth stripes and the uniform speckled forest blur map edges and invert the visual hierarchy (busy surroundings, bare playfields). Mushroom Town is invisible from the island cameras, and the halo puffs read as snow lumps stuck to the slopes.

shared_fixes.area: Sea shadow and sea concept (scene_setup, M_Sea, Cloud_SeaLayer)
shared_fixes.fix: Stop the island's shadow falling on the sea plane: exclude the sea from Sun_Key shadows with light linking, or make M_Sea mostly emissive. Commit to one concept: a soft cloud sea (a sky island, matching the world map) or a deeper teal sea with fog. Make the Cloud_SeaLayer puffs puffier (z scale at least 0.5 of xy) and halve their count.
shared_fixes.rationale: A hard navy wedge covers 25-35% of every island shot and reads as two different waters. The fix is cheap and visible in every hero image.

shared_fixes.fix: Classify a 'steep' window, or a step over 0.45 m, as a climb when it lies within CLIMB_RADIUS of a climbable whose z-span covers it, snapping to the cliff edge via face_point. Walk every route in both directions unless it is declared with m.route(..., one_way=True). Then delete the local workarounds (climb_route in 40001/40002/50000/60000, _climb_split in 1010000/1010002, edge_pair in 1000003/1000004/1010004, _check_climb in 1000002/1000006, the hand-made 2-point Rope route in 1010001) and have authors merge their split routes (0, 20000, 30000).
shared_fixes.rationale: build_report shows climb:0 on almost every route, so ladders only prove the ground on each side. One-way drops on two-way paths, such as 40000's 0.47 m lip, go unnoticed.

shared_fixes.fix: Add a pale cream/sand 'main road' surface, 5-6 m wide, for every Maple Road trail (0 through 60000) and every Rainbow Street trail (50000 -> 1000000 -> 1010000 -> 1020000 -> 1020001). Add an m.main_path(points) helper so authors can use it for the through-route between edge portals. Keep branch trails narrower and in darker dirt.
shared_fixes.rationale: The world map's defining feature is one continuous pale road. Today the main route cannot be traced in Island_Overview without the debug overlay.

shared_fixes.fix: Add 'grass_rock': warm grey-brown irregular rock sides with a rounded, slightly tapered silhouette and embedded boulders, for Maple Road rock (40000/40001/40002/50000). Add 'grass_dark_dirt': a mossier, desaturated M_Grass_Dark cap with M_Dirt_Cliff sides, for 1000002 and the forest hunting grounds. Keep stone styles for Amherst.
shared_fixes.rationale: Maple Island rock is currently built with Amherst flagstone (grass_stone), so it reads as wells and silos. Forest maps can't be told apart tonally from the open fields.

shared_fixes.fix: Add a stake or peg with a loop, or a short beam, on the upper cap, plus a top segment draped over the lip, in a light hemp colour with a slight curve. Add a leafy-vine variant for descend-only vines. Make this the single rope style and retire the local hemp_rope in 1000003/1000004, whose flat peg-beam reads as a signpost.
shared_fixes.rationale: Ropes read as freestanding knotted posts and nearly vanish in overviews (40000, 40001, 40002, 30000, 60000), so climb points are hard to spot.

shared_fixes.fix: Split the ribbon into separate rounded-end segments wherever consecutive rows differ by more than 0.08 m, and lift each segment 0.03 m above the higher surface it rests on. Drape on sloped walkables (ramps) instead of staying flat. Warn at build time when a path crosses a lip of more than 0.15 m without a ramp or stairs.
shared_fixes.rationale: Ribbons tear into notches and floating tabs at terrace seams (1000000, 1000002, 50000, 1020000), breaking the main-path read.

shared_fixes.area: Validator noise and collision proxies (scripts/validate.py, MapCtx)
shared_fixes.fix: Replace the name-based WALL_MOUNTED whitelist (validate.py line 31) with a geometric test: an instance passes if its bounding box is within 0.15 m of any terrain or architecture surface (BVH find_nearest), or if it carries an explicit wall_mounted tag set by the placing helper. The current list exempts anything with 'sign' in its name, including solid posts. Add m.collider(name, boxes) to MapCtx: it builds into <slug>_Collision (excluded from render), joins the ground index and is exempt from the hidden check. Switch the hide_render boxes in 1010001/1010003/60001 to it. Make the 'blocked' test cast 3 rays (offsets 0 and +/-0.6 m), and replace _passable()'s name exemptions with a registry 'passable' tag.
shared_fixes.rationale: About 200 false 'floating' flags and 12 hidden-object failures bury real defects, such as the 6.6 m-gap eave and the 1000001 rope foot.

shared_fixes.fix: Promote ROOM, WALL_T, cut_room, lbox, lcyl, plank_floor, banded_beam and crate_block from m1010001 to kit/interior.py. Promote the duplicated local assets (Tree_Birch_Teal defined in 6 maps, Tree_Birch_Green in 4, and Clover/Iris/Marigold/Strawberry/Butterfly) to public kit names, with public wrappers for _birch/_bush/_flower_patch. Move X1020000_TomatoGate into the kit. Fail the build if a map module imports another map module.
shared_fixes.rationale: An edit to the Weapon Store can break three other maps, and parallel map authors in the next wave will collide on these files.

shared_fixes.fix: Rebuild Flower_Patch_A/B at 300 triangles or fewer and Flower_Bed_Large at about 1.2k or fewer. Turn outlines off for Props/Foliage with a footprint under about 1 m. overall_assessment:
Where it stands: all 25 maps exist, the topology is complete (20 trails, reciprocal portals) and the whole island shares one consistent style. About a third of the maps already have strong, recognisable identities: Sen's house (20001), the Weapon Store (1010001), Tomato Field, Arch Rock (40001), Mushroom Garden, the 40000 knoll, map 0, and Southperry up close. It is not yet a cohesive first iteration, for three reasons.

1. The build can't be trusted yet. Seven maps have traversal or portal failures.
- Three of them cut other maps out of the walkable graph: 1010000's in01 (losing Townstreet and Snail Field of Flowers), 1010002's Main route (losing Snail Field of Flowers), and 1000000's in00 (losing Small Forest). The validator passed 1000000's in00 because it never checks that a route actually reaches a portal.
- The other four are local: the 1000001 rope, the 40002 vines, a 0.46 m step in 1000004, and the 1020001 WestBed route.
- On top of that, clear_routes silently deleted about 96 hand-placed props, including three landmarks named in the briefs: the 1000001 giant trunk, the 50000 mesa tree and the 1000006 umbrella leaf. So the iter1 renders show a worse island than was authored.
- VALIDATION.md is also stale, and its triangle budget was loosened from 400k to 600k.
Almost all of these are one-line fixes. Fix them first, whatever the map priority order.

2. The connecting geometry is the weakest layer. The long trails are brown wedges with 12 m vertical walls and floating rails. Ramps end in seams under terrace lips, stairs render as floating tiles, and path ribbons tear. These artifacts sit on the main route, in nearly every map and every island shot. They are shared-code fixes (shared #4-#6 and #15), not authoring work.

3. The island's identity doesn't come through at island scale.
- Southperry is landlocked: its ship sits in a raised pool about 34 m from the rim.
- The island reads as a thin pancake on stacked plinths.
- The forest is a uniform speckle.
- The main road can't be traced.
- Mushroom Town shows as a few coloured dots.

Recommended order:
- **Wave 0 (lead engineer):** shared #1 (clear_routes), #2 (validator) and #3 (layout corrections). Then rebuild and re-render, so authors see the real state before they start.
- **Wave 1 (map authors, in parallel):** the blocker or traversal fix at the top of each list, then re-placing deleted props, then priorities 1-8 (Amherst, Field West, Townstreet, Small Forest, Mushroom Town, Southperry, East Entrance, A Split Road).
- **Wave 2 (lead, alongside wave 1):** #4 trails, #5 ramps, #6 stairs and #7 portal visuals; then #8 rim and cliff (this unblocks Southperry's ship), #9 filler and #10 sea.
- **Wave 3:** the remaining maps and the style/tooling items (#11-#23).

After waves 0-2, the island should be fully walkable, with a legible route, its key landmarks visible from the island cameras, and no framework scaffolding on show. That is what I would call a cohesive first iteration.

What will still be missing, by design:
- Real terrain relief. The flat Island_Ground and plinth stacks stay. A designed heightfield (NW massif, falling valley, map z derived from height) is the iteration-2 world change, and it should not be half-done through plinth tweaks now.
- Regional grass blending across Island_Ground.
- LODs and impostors.
- A full interior redesign: 60001 gets a retheme, not a new floor plan.
- Two layout-level identity moves, held back because they cascade through other trails: the 1000000 twin-door mound for in02/in03, and Dangerous Forest as a descent.

I deliberately overrode or dropped three critic suggestions:
- 6-8 houses per Mushroom Town map: that contradicts the classic data, which has one landmark house per map, and would clutter the town.
- Spiralling 1000005's tower around a trunk: that would duplicate 1000001's signature, so it winds round a rock pillar instead.
- A 22-26 m lighthouse: too tall next to two-storey houses; I set 16-20 m.
